role: The four text lines of a sign tile entity, sent when the sign's chunk reaches the client or its text changes.
scope_reason: TileEntitySign.getDescriptionPacket sends one for every sign a client receives (built in details-blocks-s1 and pickblock-s1), but world.conf sign_editing = off keeps every sign blank (ItemSign.java:88), so it only ever carries four empty lines onto a client sign that is already blank.

members.name: S33PacketUpdateSign
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

missing: TileEntitySign.getDescriptionPacket (TileEntitySign.java:48), sent when a sign's chunk reaches the client (PlayerManager.java:554): no native counterpart; the native client renders signs from its own world state
notes: Under world.conf sign_editing = off the only text this packet could carry is four empty strings; the sign block itself is in scope. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
